economy.label: Economy
economy.definition: The organisation, coordination and overall performance of economic activity.
includes: Economic plans, controls, cooperatives and supply policies
Aggregate economic output and recovery
excludes: A single industry's physical production without economic policy

finance.label: Finance
finance.definition: Public and private money, credit, investment, insurance and financial accounts.
includes: Government revenue, expenditure, taxation and debt
Banks, currency, capital and insurance
excludes: A company's physical output without financial measures

trade.label: Trade
trade.definition: Exchange and commercial distribution of goods and services within or across borders.
includes: Imports, exports, prices, companies and markets
Trade regulation and commercial organisations

transportation.label: Transportation
transportation.definition: Systems and services moving people or goods by land, water or air.
includes: Rail, road, tram, shipping and aviation networks and traffic
Ports, transport costs, tourism and transport safety

communications.label: Communications
communications.definition: Networks and services transmitting messages, mail and broadcasts.
includes: Postal, telegraph, telephone and radio operations
Postal financial services when the postal channel is explicit
excludes: Transport described historically as communications but carrying people or cargo

labour.label: Labour
labour.definition: Employment, remuneration, work conditions and organisation of workers.
includes: Employment and placement, wages, hours and labour relations
Occupational accidents and identified worker groups
excludes: General population by occupation without employment measures

education.label: Education
education.definition: Teaching, learning and the institutions, people and resources supporting them.
includes: Schools, pupils, teachers and education expenditure
Higher, vocational, adult and special education and libraries
excludes: Religious adherents or worship without teaching

religion.label: Religion
religion.definition: Religious traditions, belief communities, worship and religious organisations.
includes: Named religions, rites, adherents and religious institutions
Missionary activity and religious propagation
excludes: An ethnic classification without religious evidence
Secular education or art merely located in a temple

press.label: Press
press.definition: Production, circulation and regulation of printed publications and news.
includes: Newspapers, journals, books, publishers and news agencies
Censorship of publishing, broadcasting or films
excludes: General telecommunications traffic without news production

culture.label: Culture
culture.definition: Artistic expression, cultural institutions, heritage and recreation.
includes: Art, music, performance, cinema, museums and archaeology
Amusements and cultural participation
excludes: Production of ordinary industrial goods without cultural content

sport.label: Sport
sport.definition: Organised physical games, athletic competition and sporting activity.
includes: Results and records, championships, clubs and sporting facilities
Recreational sports when the activity is explicit
excludes: A mountain's height without evidence of sporting use

science-and-technology.label: Science and technology
science-and-technology.definition: Scientific investigation, technical knowledge, invention and standards of measurement.
includes: Research institutions and activity, patents and inventions
Measurement systems and technical standards
excludes: Routine output of manufactured goods without technical or research content

economic-planning.label: economic planning
economic-planning.definition: Formal plans setting future economic development, investment or production objectives.
includes: Multi-year industrial plans
Planned capital outlay and production targets

economic-controls.label: economic controls
economic-controls.definition: Administrative direction or restriction of economic activity and resource allocation.
includes: Industry control laws
Production allocation, licensing and compulsory coordination

price-controls.label: price controls
price-controls.definition: Rules fixing or limiting prices, rents or permitted margins.
includes: Official maximum or minimum prices
Enforcement of price ceilings

inflation.label: inflation
inflation.definition: A sustained rise in the general price level or loss of purchasing power.
includes: Inflation rates and general price-level increases
Currency depreciation explicitly analysed as inflation
excludes: Exchange rates without evidence of domestic inflation

cooperatives.label: cooperatives
cooperatives.definition: Member-owned or mutual organisations conducting shared economic business.
includes: Consumer, producer, agricultural and credit cooperatives
Cooperative membership, capital and business
excludes: Trade unions organised for labour representation

reconstruction.label: reconstruction
reconstruction.definition: Restoration of economic assets, activity or infrastructure after damage or disruption.
includes: Postwar reconstruction
Rebuilding damaged railways, factories or settlements

food-supply-and-rationing.label: food supply and rationing
food-supply-and-rationing.definition: Provision, distribution and controlled allocation of food for consumption.
includes: Food balances, provisioning, stocks and ration allowances
Government food procurement and distribution
excludes: Crop output without supply or distribution measures

state-monopolies.label: state monopolies
state-monopolies.definition: Exclusive state rights or monopolistic state enterprises controlling specified products or services.
includes: Salt, tobacco, opium and alcohol monopolies
Monopoly sales, receipts and administration
excludes: Private market concentration without state exclusivity

rural-development.label: rural development
rural-development.definition: Coordinated measures to improve rural economic conditions and infrastructure.
includes: Rural improvement programmes
Village development and agricultural settlement support

production-subsidies.label: production subsidies
production-subsidies.definition: Public grants or financial assistance supporting production or the operation of economic services.
includes: Industry and farm production grants
Subsidised shipping or air services and producer incentives
excludes: Poor relief or household welfare grants

public-budgets.label: public budgets
public-budgets.definition: Government revenue, expenditure and budget accounts at national or local level.
includes: General and special accounts
Municipal budgets and public expenditure by service

taxation.label: taxation
taxation.definition: Taxes, their assessment, rates, receipts and distribution.
includes: Income, inheritance, business and other taxes
Tax burden per person or household
excludes: Government revenue entirely from non-tax sources

public-debt.label: public debt
public-debt.definition: Borrowing liabilities and debt service of national or local governments.
includes: Government loans, treasury debt and municipal bonds
Debt outstanding, issuance and repayment
excludes: Corporate borrowing without public guarantee or liability

banking.label: banking
banking.definition: Banks and their organisation, accounts, clearing and financial business.
includes: Central, ordinary, special and foreign banks
Bank assets, liabilities, deposits, loans and clearing houses

savings-and-loans.label: savings and loans
savings-and-loans.definition: Deposits, savings and lending balances or transactions.
includes: Savings deposits, bank loans and postal savings
Loan amounts by borrower or purpose
excludes: Interest rates without loan or deposit amounts
Securities issuance without lending or saving

currency.label: currency
currency.definition: Monetary systems, coins, notes and reserves supporting money circulation.
includes: Currency issuance, circulation, metallic content and gold reserves
Monetary standards and convertibility
excludes: Mined gold output without monetary use

foreign-exchange.label: foreign exchange
foreign-exchange.definition: Conversion, valuation and control of one currency against another.
includes: Exchange rates and quotations
Foreign-exchange transactions and controls
excludes: Merchandise exports without currency conversion measures

securities-and-investment.label: securities and investment
securities-and-investment.definition: Investment capital, tradable financial claims and their returns or holdings.
includes: Shares, bonds, debentures, trusts and capital issues
Securities prices, yields and portfolios

insurance-and-pensions.label: insurance and pensions
insurance-and-pensions.definition: Insurance, annuities, retirement pensions and organised risk pooling.
includes: Life, fire, marine and health insurance business
Pension funds, payments and entitlement schedules
excludes: Poor relief without insurance or pension entitlement
All mortality tables without an insurance context

national-income-and-wealth.label: national income and wealth
national-income-and-wealth.definition: Aggregate income, economic product or stocks of national wealth.
includes: National income and its composition
National wealth, aggregate product and per-capita measures
excludes: Commodity output alone without an economy-wide aggregate

foreign-loans.label: foreign loans
foreign-loans.definition: Loans raised from or owed to lenders outside the borrowing territory.
includes: Foreign public loans and externally issued corporate debt
Foreign loan service, terms and balances

foreign-investment.label: foreign investment
foreign-investment.definition: Capital invested across territorial borders or held by foreign investors.
includes: Foreign-owned enterprises and capital holdings
Foreign direct and portfolio investment by origin or destination

indemnities.label: indemnities
indemnities.definition: Financial obligations imposed as compensation, particularly by treaties or conflict settlements.
includes: War indemnity principal and service
Customs receipts assigned to indemnity payments
excludes: Ordinary loans without an indemnity obligation

customs-revenue.label: customs revenue
customs-revenue.definition: Revenue collected by customs authorities from duties and related customs levies.
includes: Customs receipts by port or duty
Maritime customs revenue and its allocation
excludes: Trade values merely recorded by customs

likin.label: likin
likin.definition: The historical Chinese internal transit and commercial levy known as likin.
includes: Likin assessment, collection and receipts
Likin stations and abolition

salt-tax.label: salt tax
salt-tax.definition: Taxes or fiscal levies assessed specifically on salt.
includes: Salt duty, tax receipts and fiscal administration
Tax rates on salt production or sales
excludes: Monopoly sales receipts not identified as tax

land-tax.label: land tax
land-tax.definition: Taxes assessed on land, its value or agricultural landholding.
includes: Land-tax assessments, rates and receipts
Agricultural land tax and cadastral fiscal charges
excludes: Land values or registration without tax measures

mutual-credit.label: mutual credit
mutual-credit.definition: Mutual lending and pooled credit arrangements among participating members.
includes: Mujin and rotating mutual-credit associations
Mutual-credit membership, funds and lending
excludes: Insurance mutual aid without credit activity

pawnshops.label: pawnshops
pawnshops.definition: Pawnbroking institutions and loans secured on pledged movable goods.
includes: Public and private pawnshops
Pledged goods, loans, capital and pawnbroking charges
excludes: Mortgage lending secured on real property
All small loans without pledged collateral

interest-rates.label: interest rates
interest-rates.definition: The rates charged or paid for borrowing, deposits or discounting credit.
includes: Bank lending and deposit rates
Central-bank discount rates and money-market rates
excludes: Share prices or dividend yields without a credit rate

public-property.label: public property
public-property.definition: Assets and property owned by national or local public authorities.
includes: Public land and buildings
Government property stocks, sales and asset values

agricultural-credit.label: agricultural credit
agricultural-credit.definition: Loans, credit institutions and financing explicitly serving agriculture or farmers.
includes: Farm loans and agricultural banks
Credit for land improvement, seed or farm equipment
excludes: All rural banking without agricultural purpose

head-tax.label: head tax
head-tax.definition: A fixed tax assessed per person or taxable individual.
includes: Poll tax rates and receipts
Taxpayer counts for personal capitation taxes

domestic-trade.label: domestic trade
domestic-trade.definition: Commercial exchange within a territory's domestic market.
includes: Internal trade flows, retail and wholesale sales
Domestic distribution by region or commodity

imports.label: imports
imports.definition: Goods entering a territory from outside its stated trade boundary.
includes: Imports by commodity, origin, port, value or quantity
Import dependence and import trade indices
excludes: Goods merely passing through without entry to the importing market

exports.label: exports
exports.definition: Goods leaving a territory across its stated trade boundary.
includes: Exports by commodity, destination, port, value or quantity
Export trade indices and export shares
excludes: Services or income transfers without goods exports

tariffs.label: tariffs
tariffs.definition: Schedules, rates and rules of customs duties on cross-border goods.
includes: Import and export duty rates
Tariff classifications, exemptions and tariff changes
excludes: Customs receipts without rates or tariff rules

prices.label: prices
prices.definition: Observed or quoted prices and price indices of goods or services.
includes: Wholesale and retail commodity prices
Market quotations and price indices
excludes: Administrative price ceilings without observed prices

companies.label: companies
companies.definition: Commercial enterprises, their organisation, ownership, capital and business results.
includes: Company counts, corporate forms and capitalisation
Company balance sheets, subsidiaries and profits
excludes: A mere incidental company name in a commodity table

business-associations.label: business associations
business-associations.definition: Organisations representing or coordinating commercial and industrial businesses.
includes: Chambers of commerce, merchant guilds and industry associations
Business association membership and functions
excludes: Member-owned trading cooperatives unless also an association

re-exports.label: re exports
re-exports.definition: Exports of goods previously imported into the same trade territory.
includes: Re-export values and commodities
Foreign goods exported again from entrepots
excludes: Goods recorded solely as transit cargo

transit-trade.label: transit trade
transit-trade.definition: Goods passing through a territory en route between other origins and destinations.
includes: Transit cargo and transit trade routes
Through trade under customs transit arrangements
excludes: All port cargo without evidence of transit status

advertising.label: advertising
advertising.definition: Commercial promotion through advertisements and related services.
includes: Advertising expenditure, agencies and advertisement receipts
Published commercial advertisements as the tabulated subject

warehousing.label: warehousing
warehousing.definition: Commercial storage of goods and the operation of warehouses.
includes: Goods in godowns
Warehouse stocks, capacity, receipts and storage business
excludes: All unsold factory stock without warehousing
Government grain reserves without storage measures

markets-and-exchanges.label: markets and exchanges
markets-and-exchanges.definition: Organised venues or institutions for trading goods, securities or commercial claims.
includes: Commodity markets and stock exchanges
Exchange turnover, listings and market institutions
excludes: Prices alone without a market institution or trading venue
Clearing houses handling bank settlement only

intra-imperial-trade.label: intra imperial trade
intra-imperial-trade.definition: Trade between territories or political units within the same empire.
includes: Metropole-colony and intercolonial imports and exports
Trade explicitly inclusive of other parts of an empire
excludes: All trade with a dominant foreign power
Yen-bloc trade without evidence of shared imperial jurisdiction

railways.label: railways
railways.definition: Railway infrastructure, rolling stock, services, traffic and operating results.
includes: State, local, light and industrial railways
Rail mileage, trains, passengers, freight and railway accounts
excludes: Street tram services identified as trams

roads-and-bridges.label: roads and bridges
roads-and-bridges.definition: Road and bridge infrastructure, construction, condition and financing.
includes: Road mileage and classification
Bridge counts and road or bridge works
excludes: Vehicles and bus traffic without infrastructure measures
Railway bridges tabulated only as railway assets

road-transport.label: road transport
road-transport.definition: Movement of people or goods by road and the vehicles or services used.
includes: Motor buses, cars, taxis, lorries and bicycles in transport
Vehicle registration, road traffic and bus routes
excludes: Road length without traffic or vehicles

shipping.label: shipping
shipping.definition: Waterborne transport, merchant fleets and ship operations.
includes: Registered ships, tonnage, sea routes and shipping companies
Seaborne passengers, cargo and operating results
excludes: Fishing catch without transport or fleet measures

ports.label: ports
ports.definition: Harbours, docks and port facilities and traffic.
includes: Ship entrances and clearances
Cargo loaded or unloaded and port capacity
excludes: National ship totals without a port measure

aviation.label: aviation
aviation.definition: Civil air transport, aircraft operation and aviation infrastructure.
includes: Air routes, schedules, passengers and air freight
Airfields, civil aviators and air transport services
excludes: Air force combat units without civil aviation content

tourism.label: tourism
tourism.definition: Travel for visiting or recreation and services accommodating visitors.
includes: Tourist and foreign-visitor numbers and spending
Hotels, travel services and tourist attractions in a travel context
excludes: Passenger counts without visitor or tourism evidence

trams.label: trams
trams.definition: Street or interurban tram systems confirmed by service context, rather than railway terminology alone.
includes: Streetcars and urban street tram services
Interurban tram routes, passenger traffic and accounts when their tram character is confirmed
excludes: Ordinary, light, industrial or hand-pushed railways without street or interurban tram context
The term 軌道 alone, or a broad translation as tramway without functional evidence

inland-navigation.label: inland navigation
inland-navigation.definition: Water transport on rivers, canals and inland lakes.
includes: River voyage routes and results
Inland vessels, river ports and canal traffic

freight-and-transport-costs.label: freight and transport costs
freight-and-transport-costs.definition: Charges, rates and financial costs of moving passengers or goods.
includes: Freight rates, fares, charterage and baggage charges
Transport operating costs and route charge schedules

navigation-aids.label: navigation aids
navigation-aids.definition: Services and installations assisting safe navigation.
includes: Lighthouses, buoys, beacons and pilots
Navigation signals and aids to passage
excludes: Ships or ports without navigational aids

transport-accidents.label: transport accidents
transport-accidents.definition: Accidents and casualties arising from transport operations.
includes: Shipwrecks, railway crashes and civil aviation accidents
Transport accident rates, losses and casualties
excludes: Storm losses without identified transport incidents

postal-services.label: postal services
postal-services.definition: Collection, conveyance and delivery of mail and parcels through postal networks.
includes: Post offices, mail routes, items handled and postal fees
Airmail and international mail

telegraph.label: telegraph
telegraph.definition: Transmission of written messages by wired, cable or wireless telegraphy.
includes: Telegraph lines, offices, cables and telegram traffic
Radiotelegraph services

telephone.label: telephone
includes: Telephone lines, offices, subscribers and calls
International and radio telephone services

radio.label: radio
radio.definition: Wireless broadcasting and radio communication systems.
includes: Broadcasting stations, receivers and listeners
Radio transmission networks and wireless services
excludes: A wired telephone network without radio transmission

postal-remittances.label: postal remittances
postal-remittances.definition: Money transfers made through postal money orders or postal giro systems.
includes: Postal money orders, transfers and remittances
Postal transfer accounts and transaction values
excludes: Migrant remittances without an identified postal channel

employment-and-unemployment.label: employment and unemployment
employment-and-unemployment.definition: Numbers, distribution and movement of employed, unemployed or economically active workers.
includes: Workforce counts, labour turnover and unemployment rates
Workers by industry, enterprise or employment status
excludes: Population by occupation alone without work status

wages.label: wages
wages.definition: Pay and monetary or in-kind remuneration for work.
includes: Daily and monthly wages, salaries and wage indices
Official pay scales and earnings by worker group

working-conditions.label: working conditions
working-conditions.definition: Terms and circumstances under which labour is performed.
includes: Hours, days, rest periods, workplace welfare and labour law
Employment contract conditions and factory regulation
excludes: General housing statistics without a work connection

trade-unions.label: trade unions
trade-unions.definition: Worker organisations formed to represent labour interests.
includes: Union membership, branches and occupational coverage
Worker union activity and labour movement organisations

labour-disputes.label: labour disputes
labour-disputes.definition: Conflicts between workers and employers over employment and their settlement.
includes: Strikes, lockouts and disputes by cause, duration or industry
Labour conciliation and arbitration
excludes: Tenant disputes without an employment relationship

child-labour.label: child labour
child-labour.definition: Employment or working conditions of children and young workers.
includes: Child factory workers and minimum working ages
Employment statistics explicitly identifying under-age workers
excludes: Age breakdowns lacking a child or youth worker category

women-workers.label: women workers
women-workers.definition: Women's employment, occupations and working conditions as an explicit subject.
includes: Female workforce counts and participation
Women's wages and occupations
excludes: A sex breakdown unrelated to work

employment-placement.label: employment placement
employment-placement.definition: Services matching people to jobs or arranging recruitment.
includes: Employment exchanges, vacancies and placements
Public and private recruitment offices

industrial-accidents.label: industrial accidents
industrial-accidents.definition: Workplace accidents, injuries and occupational casualties.
includes: Factory and mine accidents
Occupational accident rates and compensation cases
excludes: Transport accidents without a workplace relation

schools-and-pupils.label: schools and pupils
schools-and-pupils.definition: Educational institutions, enrolments, attendance and student populations across school types.
includes: School and pupil totals
School-age children and attendance obligations

primary-education.label: primary education
primary-education.definition: The initial compulsory or elementary stage of formal schooling.
includes: Elementary and primary schools and pupils
Primary school-age children and attendance
excludes: Secondary schools even when the English name is higher school

secondary-education.label: secondary education
secondary-education.definition: Formal schooling following the primary stage and preceding higher education.
includes: Middle schools, secondary schools and pupils
Higher schools where their preparatory secondary status is established
excludes: Assuming every institution called higher or special is secondary

higher-education.label: higher education
higher-education.definition: Postsecondary institutions and advanced academic instruction.
includes: Universities, colleges, degrees and postsecondary specialist schools
Higher-education enrolments and institutions
excludes: Institutions called higher whose historical level is unresolved

vocational-education.label: vocational education
vocational-education.definition: Organised instruction preparing learners for a trade, technical occupation or profession.
includes: Technical, industrial, agricultural and professional schools
Vocational courses and youth vocational schools

teachers.label: teachers
teachers.definition: Teaching staff, their qualifications, licensing, employment and pay.
includes: Teacher counts, licences and certification
School teachers and kindergarten educators
excludes: General civil servants without teaching roles

libraries.label: libraries
libraries.definition: Institutions and collections providing organised access to books and other materials.
includes: Public, school and research libraries
Library holdings, readers and circulation

literacy-and-adult-education.label: literacy and adult education
literacy-and-adult-education.definition: Ability to read and write and organised instruction for adults outside ordinary school progression.
includes: Literacy rates and illiteracy
Adult classes, continuing education and popular education
excludes: All youth schooling without adult or literacy content

students-abroad.label: students abroad
students-abroad.definition: Students pursuing education outside their home territory.
includes: Government-sponsored overseas students
Students studying in Japan from another territory

mission-schools.label: mission schools
mission-schools.definition: Educational institutions founded, operated or explicitly supported by religious missions.
includes: Mission schools, their pupils and teachers
Religious mission education
excludes: Every private or religious school without a mission connection

education-finance.label: education finance
education-finance.definition: Funding, revenue, expenditure and financial support specifically for education.
includes: Educational budgets and school expenditure
School fees, scholarships and student financial relief
excludes: All expenditure of a welfare department without educational evidence

traditional-schools.label: traditional schools
traditional-schools.definition: Institutions explicitly practising established premodern or indigenous forms of formal learning.
includes: Classical academies, temple schools and traditional private schools
Traditional curricula and school populations
excludes: Modern private schools without traditional instruction

teacher-training.label: teacher training
teacher-training.definition: Preparation and professional education of teachers.
includes: Normal schools and teacher-training colleges
Teacher education students and courses
excludes: Ordinary vocational schools for other professions

kindergartens.label: kindergartens
kindergartens.definition: Preschool educational institutions for children before primary entry.
includes: Kindergarten classes, pupils and educators
Preschool education statistics
excludes: Childcare or foundling care without educational provision

special-education.label: special education
special-education.definition: Education explicitly adapted for disabled learners or other defined special educational needs.
includes: Schools for blind, deaf or other disabled pupils
Special-education enrolment and provision
excludes: Higher special schools meaning specialist professional education
aliases: schools for blind and deaf learners

language-education.label: language education
language-education.definition: Teaching and learning of languages as an explicit educational activity.
includes: Foreign-language schools and courses
Language instruction, teachers and learners
excludes: Colonial assimilation inferred solely from language of a table

school-boarding.label: school boarding
school-boarding.definition: Residential accommodation and board provided for school or college pupils.
includes: Boarding schools, dormitories and resident pupils
Educational boarding fees and provision

apprenticeships.label: apprenticeships
apprenticeships.definition: Occupational training through a recognised apprenticeship relationship or structured work placement.
includes: Apprentice numbers, contracts and training
Registered apprenticeship systems

shinto.label: shinto
shinto.definition: Shinto beliefs, communities, rites and institutions.
includes: Shinto shrines, priests and adherents
Shrine and sect Shinto when specified
excludes: All Japanese religion or ancestor rites by default

buddhism.label: buddhism
buddhism.definition: Buddhist traditions, communities, clergy and institutions.
includes: Buddhist temples, sects and adherents
Buddhist religious propagation

christianity.label: christianity
christianity.definition: Christian churches, communities, denominations and religious activity.
includes: Christian adherents, clergy and churches
Catholic, Protestant and Orthodox institutions
excludes: Mission schools without evidence of Christian affiliation

other-religions.label: other religions
other-religions.definition: Named religious traditions without a dedicated controlled tag or explicitly residual religious categories.
includes: Hinduism and Sikhism when identified
Source categories explicitly labelled other religions
excludes: Traditions already represented by a dedicated religion tag

confucianism.label: confucianism
confucianism.definition: Confucian religious, ritual or institutional traditions when explicitly identified.
includes: Confucian temples, rites and religious communities
Confucian religious organisations

taoism.label: taoism
taoism.definition: Taoist or Daoist religious traditions and institutions.
includes: Taoist temples, clergy, rites and adherents
Taoist religious associations
excludes: Philosophical text production without religious content

islam.label: islam
islam.definition: Muslim religious communities, beliefs and institutions.
includes: Mosques, imams and Muslim adherents
Islamic religious organisations and education
excludes: Middle Eastern trade without religious content

judaism.label: judaism
judaism.definition: Jewish religious communities, practices and institutions.
includes: Synagogues, rabbis and Jewish religious adherents
Jewish religious organisations
excludes: Jewish ethnicity alone without religious evidence
Foreign residents presumed to follow Judaism

missions.label: missions
missions.definition: Organised religious propagation and missionary personnel or establishments.
includes: Missionaries by nationality or denomination
Mission stations and religious propagation
excludes: Mission schools when only ordinary school operations are measured

ancestor-rites.label: ancestor rites
ancestor-rites.definition: Ritual observance and worship specifically directed to ancestors.
includes: Ancestor worship, ancestral halls and rites
Ritual institutions for ancestral observance
excludes: All Confucianism or folk religion by assumption

folk-religion.label: folk religion
folk-religion.definition: Local or popular religious traditions explicitly identified as such.
includes: Village cults, local deities and popular religious practices
Folk-religious institutions and observances
excludes: Any religion practised by indigenous people
Named institutional religions solely because locally popular

religious-institutions.label: religious institutions
religious-institutions.definition: Organisations, personnel and establishments providing religious worship or religious governance.
includes: Shrines, temples, churches, clergy and religious associations
Comparative institutional statistics across religions
excludes: Adherent totals alone without institutional measures
Religious schools tabulated only as schools

tenrikyo.label: tenrikyo
tenrikyo.definition: Tenrikyo religious communities, teachings and institutions.
includes: Tenrikyo adherents, clergy, churches and propagation
Tenrikyo organisations explicitly identified
excludes: Automatic reassignment to Shinto based solely on historical official grouping

newspapers.label: newspapers
newspapers.definition: Regular news publications issued as newspapers and the enterprises producing them.
includes: Newspaper titles, circulation and publishers
Newspaper capital, prices and publication counts
excludes: All printed publications without newspaper identification

periodicals.label: periodicals
periodicals.definition: Serial print publications other than newspapers, including journals and magazines.
includes: Magazine and journal titles, circulation and publication counts
Periodical publishing

books.label: books
books.definition: Books and other monographic printed publications and their publication or circulation.
includes: Book titles, editions, subjects and publishing
Book imports and exports
excludes: Serial newspapers and magazines unless combined publication statistics are indivisible

news-agencies.label: news agencies
news-agencies.definition: Organisations gathering and distributing news to media outlets.
includes: News services and wire agencies
Agency personnel, offices and business
excludes: Newspaper publishers without an agency function

censorship.label: censorship
censorship.definition: Official review, restriction or suppression of publication, performance or public expression.
includes: Press restrictions and censored books
Film censorship and content approvals
excludes: Criminal arrests without an expression or publication link

arts-and-music.label: arts and music
arts-and-music.definition: Visual arts, artistic crafts and musical creation, performance or institutions.
includes: Art exhibitions, painters, arts boards and music societies
Art schools and artistic awards when art is the subject
excludes: Ordinary industrial output without artistic content

theatre-and-cinema.label: theatre and cinema
theatre-and-cinema.definition: Dramatic performance, film production, distribution and exhibition.
includes: Theatres, cinemas, films and attendance
Film producers and motion-picture exhibition

museums-and-heritage.label: museums and heritage
museums-and-heritage.definition: Museums, collections and recognised cultural or historic heritage.
includes: Museum institutions and collections
National treasures, historic monuments and heritage protection

recreation-and-amusements.label: recreation and amusements
recreation-and-amusements.definition: Leisure, entertainment and amusement activities outside organised sport.
includes: Amusement venues, parks and public entertainment
Non-sport recreational participation
excludes: Theatre or cinema alone where the more precise tag suffices

archaeology.label: archaeology
archaeology.definition: Investigation and material remains of past human societies.
includes: Archaeological excavations, sites and antiquities
Archaeological research and collections

sports-records.label: sports records
sports-records.definition: Documented competitive sporting results, performance records and champions.
includes: Championship winners and match results
National and world athletic records
excludes: Sporting club or venue lists without results

scientific-research.label: scientific research
scientific-research.definition: Systematic scientific investigation and the organisations and resources supporting it.
includes: Research institutes, academies and scientific councils
Research personnel, projects, findings and expenditure
excludes: Production of scientific instruments without research activity

patents-and-trademarks.label: patents and trademarks
patents-and-trademarks.definition: Legal registration and protection of inventions, utility models, designs and commercial marks.
includes: Patent, utility-model, design and trademark registrations
Inventors and industrial-property rights

measurement-and-units.label: measurement and units
measurement-and-units.definition: Systems, standards and conversions for quantitative measurement.
includes: Weights, measures and monetary-unit equivalents
Metrology, measurement standards and unit conversion tables
excludes: Any table containing numbers or units
Instrument manufacture without standards or conversion content

tags.label: balance of payments
tags.definition: Accounts of economic transactions between a territory and the rest of the world, including goods, services, income and capital flows.
includes: International balance-of-payments accounts
Current and capital account balances

tags.label: services and invisible trade
tags.definition: Cross-border service earnings and payments and other receipts historically grouped as invisible trade.
includes: Invisible trade accounts
International transport, tourism, insurance and other service receipts
excludes: All capital flows merely because they are non-merchandise

tags.label: migrant remittances
tags.definition: Money sent by migrants or overseas residents to people or households in their territory of origin.
includes: Emigrant remittances
Transfers home by overseas communities
excludes: Postal transfers without a migrant connection
Foreign investment or public foreign loans

tags.label: labour productivity
tags.definition: Output relative to labour input, measured per worker or unit of working time.
includes: Output or production value per operative
Indices explicitly measuring labour productivity
excludes: Worker totals without output per labour input

tags.label: cost of living
tags.definition: The expenditure needed to maintain a defined household or individual living standard and its index over time.
includes: Cost-of-living indices
Minimum living expenses and worker-family living costs
excludes: Wage rates without a living-cost measure

tags.label: sports organisations and facilities
tags.definition: Clubs, associations and physical venues established for sporting activities.
includes: Horse race clubs and sporting associations
Golf links, playing fields and sports venues
excludes: Championship results without organisational or venue measures
General amusement venues without a sporting function

tags.label: calendars and time
tags.definition: Systems for reckoning years, dates and time and converting between calendar or time conventions.
includes: Era and year-name equivalence tables
International time charts and time-zone comparisons
excludes: Any historical table merely containing years
Sunrise and sunset observations without time-system comparison

tags.label: religious affiliation
tags.definition: Counts or distribution of people by stated religious membership or adherence.
includes: Followers of multiple religions
Adherents classified by religious group
excludes: Clergy or temple counts without adherent measures
